130: **The three most relevant papers in three different fields each state that the depth-discontinuity case lies outside their forward model** — Levin et al. 2009 ("a general problem for all computational extended-DOF systems … most artifacts can be eliminated with simple manual layer refinement"), Nagahara et al. 2008 ("we have not explicitly modeled occlusions"), Aguet et al. 2008 ("ignores potential out-of-focus contributions from beneath the surface").
